Dana: Follow-up to the postmortem - proposed SLO changes and owners.
Leo: What's changing?
Dana: Keep SLA 99.95%, add per-endpoint throughput soft-SLO (200 rps per cluster) and temporarily allow p99 latency uplift +25% for gen endpoints while batching lands.
Sora: Don't reduce alerting — keep p99 paging but move to a higher threshold.
Dana: Agreed. New alert will page only on sustained 25% uplift >30m, otherwise warn.
Leo: paste rule?
Dana: ```
ALERT SLO_P99_Sustained_Uplift
IF (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(req_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, endpoint))) > baseline_p99 * 1.25
FOR 30m
LABELS {severity="page"}
```
Sora: Ownership: dashboard panel (Dana, due 2176545000), regression job + alert (Leo, due 2176546800), batching perf investigation (Sora, due 2176550400).
infra-bot: Incident #5067 resolved - cause: worker pool saturation; mitigation: throttled background jobs and increased KV TTL.
